recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a solid black mountain silhouette at the bottom against a deep blue night sky filled with soft, airbrushed aurora borealis effects in rainbow hues. The center contains a complex, multi-layered typographic emblem with a ribbon and horizontal bars.
coreVisualRelationships: Black silhouette anchors the vibrant, soft-focus sky
Geometric typography contrasts with organic light streaks
Primary colors in the logo pop against the cool blue background
coreInvariants: Solid black mountain silhouette at the base
Soft, vertical airbrushed light streaks in the mid-ground
Deep indigo to violet gradient sky

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central typographic emblem occupies the upper-middle third; mountain silhouette occupies the bottom quarter.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid black mountain range at the base provides a heavy foundation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright central logo, moves down to the mountain peaks, then follows the vertical light streaks back up to the top text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper corners and lower mountain area to allow the central graphic to breathe.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central graphic and aurora streaks against a dark, low-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, condensed slab serifs for main titles
Wide-tracked, light sans-serifs for secondary metadata
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main title features a thick blue drop shadow and orange fill
Top text uses extreme letter spacing (tracking)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy condensed slab serif paired with wide-tracked light sans-serif for a classic 80s commercial look.

preserve: The horizontal bars framing the main text
The extreme tracking on the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and structure of the main title.
Appropriate for the wide-tracked metadata text at the top and bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep indigo night sky with a solid black mountain silhouette at the bottom. In the middle third, add soft, vertical airbrushed streaks of light in a spectrum of colors (yellow, green, pink, blue) to mimic the aurora borealis. Add one small, bright four-pointed star glint in the upper right quadrant.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center a graphic emblem consisting of a white arched ribbon above two horizontal green bars. Place a large, condensed orange slab-serif title between the bars with a thick blue outline. Add secondary text in a wide-tracked sans-serif at the very top and very bottom of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the mountain silhouette solid black with no detail?
Are the aurora streaks soft and airbrushed rather than sharp?
Is the central text framed by horizontal bars and a ribbon?
Is the top text extremely wide-tracked?

adjustableVariables: Color of the main title fill
mustRedesign: The exact shape of the mountain peaks to avoid direct copying

mustAchieve: Smooth airbrushed gradients in the sky
Clean, sharp vector-like lines for the central emblem
High contrast between the black base and the blue sky

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ribbon is white and arched.
Verify the presence of the green horizontal bars.
Check that the aurora streaks are vertical and multi-colored.
Confirm the mountain is a pure black silhouette.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Solid Black Silhouette Base] + [Airbrushed Aurora Sky] + [Stacked Geometric Emblem with Ribbon and Bars].
